summary: Iteration 6 REGRESSION testing of Playspintech after E1 applied React Code Review fixes (wrapped page-level `load` functions in useCallback across 10 site pages + AuditLogTab, and memoized Context provider values in auth.jsx/theme.jsx/i18n.jsx). Frontend-only per request. RESULT: All 12 in-scope regression scenarios PASS. No infinite loops, no runaway re-renders, no double-fetch beyond React 18 StrictMode's expected dev-mode 2x invocation, no console errors, no 'Maximum update depth' warnings, and no memory leaks under stress.

Every page mounts its expected endpoints (2x each due to StrictMode) and remains COMPLETELY IDLE afterward (0 additional calls in 3s window). No page loops.

verifications_passed.rapid_nav_stress_no_memory_leak: PASS — 3 rounds × 6 pages (18 navigations) produced 132 API calls (7-8/page, reasonable). Then 4s trailing wait = 0 additional calls. No zombie effects, no leaked timers.

verifications_passed.context_providers_memoized: PASS by code inspection — auth.jsx:87-90 wraps value in useMemo with deps [user, site, loading, refresh, isAdmin, adminSiteId, activeSiteId]; refresh/bootstrap in useCallback. theme.jsx:21-23 toggle useCallback + useMemo value. i18n.jsx:175-181 t/toggle useCallback + useMemo value. All correct — no stale closures, no re-render storms.

critical_code_review_comments: auth.jsx: `value` useMemo deps list intentionally omits `login`, `completeLogin2FA`, `logout`, `setAdminSiteId` (defined inline every render). Because value.identity DOES change on every render already (due to these inline fns re-created), the useMemo essentially only helps skip identity change when deps didn't change AT ALL. In practice this is fine (auth context is a top-level provider and does not re-render often), but for strictest correctness wrap those 4 functions in useCallback too. Non-blocking; no observable regression.

Reports.jsx: `doRollover` internally calls `loadMonthly()` — this is inside a useCallback-wrapped closure. Fine because loadMonthly is a stable ref within same render, but if loadMonthly deps change during rollover flow you'll capture stale ref. Consider destructuring latest ref via useRef pattern or including loadMonthly in doRollover deps (currently doRollover is NOT wrapped in useCallback anyway — fine).

AdminHome.jsx AuditLogTab: `useEffect(()=>{load()}, [load])` where load deps=[offset, filter]. Correct memoization. Filter change also calls `setOffset(0)` (line 529) — both state updates get batched by React 18 automatic batching, resulting in exactly 1 refetch. Verified in TEST 3 (1 call after filter change).

Positive: every one of the 10 pages follows the SAME clean idiom: `const load = useCallback(async () => {...}, [depIfAny]); useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]);` — consistent, correct, and eliminates the previously reported stale-closure risk.

DailyEntry.jsx: loadForDate deps=[] (empty) BUT called with `d` argument (loadForDate(date) at line 40) — clever pattern, avoids re-creation on `date` state change. Verified with TEST 8: date change triggers exactly 1 refetch. This is arguably even better than closing over `date` because the function ref itself stays stable across date changes. Nice.
React.StrictMode is enabled in /app/frontend/src/index.js — this causes the 2x mount API-call pattern seen in dev but NOT in production builds. E1 should be aware this is intentional and expected.

context_for_next_testing_agent: React Code Review fixes (useCallback on all page loads + memoized Context providers) are FULLY VALIDATED with zero regressions. Every site page's data-load behavior is now: 1 fetch on mount (2x in dev due to StrictMode), 1 refetch when its deps change (date/year/month/offset/filter), 0 background/idle traffic. Auth/Theme/i18n contexts behave identically to before but with fewer downstream re-renders. If a future iteration wants to enforce production-mode exact-1 fetch behavior, either disable StrictMode locally for measurement or run a production build. No further regression testing needed for this Code Review batch.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs. The 2x-call pattern seen on every mount is React 18 StrictMode's intentional dev-mode double-invocation of useEffect (index.js:18-22 wraps App in <React.StrictMode>), which is designed to surface impure effect logic. This does NOT occur in production builds. Proof it is NOT an infinite loop: 3-second post-mount idle wait consistently returned 0 additional API calls on all 10 site pages + admin panel + audit tab.
